title: I finally finished something, it's scary
author: gopwallos
selftext:
I won't keep this long, but I finally made something I feel like sharing with others. I know that won't seem like much, but there were SOOO many failed prototypes and long nights to get here. Opus 5.5 was the real game changer for me. I don't know what it is about that model, but it just understood immediately the vision I had for this project. I've always wanted to make my own card game ever since I first played Yu-Gi-Oh! as a kid. But as I'm sure most of you can guess, this is no easy task. Over the years, I've found less time to play and have lately been drifting to mobile card games. But to my unsurprise most if not all of these games were flooded with microtransactions and pay-to-win tactics. I just wanted a simple but competitive card game that isn't pay-to-win or dominated by a toxic meta. So, after about 6 months of development between two jobs, I made this. Battle online against random people or face off against a friend in a local match. Currently sitting at 120 cards, with plenty more cards planned for the future. Also, the entire game was AI-generated. In the future, I plan to replace the card art with professional work. You can play the game now in your browser. Please, I would love any feedback or like to know any bugs you encounter while playing. Hope you enjoy!

 [https://tip390.itch.io/power-pile](https://tip390.itch.io/power-pile)
